item.title: How Pornography Impacts Marriage
item.description: Pornography — whether used infrequently or as an addiction — is a big deal. It sacrifices true intimacy, forsakes a real relationship for a lying imitation, and twists the true purpose of sex. Porn rewires the brain to focus on "you" — not on intimacy.
